card: Refactors CI build scripts to explicitly specify CMake targets via BUILD_TARGETS instead of relying on implicit target prepending via GOAL. It also parses targets into a bash array using eval, removing the need to disable shellcheck SC2086 warnings. This simplifies CI maintenance and removes implicit configuration behavior for contributors working on CI environments. It has no external dependencies.
changed_since_previous: No changes to the patch; this description refreshes the initial entry with standard fields.
evidence: PR description: '"all" is added to the build targets unless GOAL is "all" or contains "codegen". This implicit translation can be confusing, so explicitly spell out the targets as "all", "all deploy", etc., where needed.'
problem: CI scripts implicitly modified build targets by prepending 'all' unless GOAL was 'all' or matched '*codegen*', creating confusing implicit behavior in CI setup scripts. Additionally, passing the unquoted targets variable directly into cmake commands required disabling shellcheck warning SC2086.

risk.why: A typo in CI build targets could fail CI builds or fail to build an expected target, affecting CI test runners.

scope_notes: Small mechanical cleanup across CI setup scripts.
summary: Refactors CI build scripts by replacing the GOAL environment variable with BUILD_TARGETS across CI environment configs. It eliminates the implicit logic that prepended 'all' to build targets and parses the target string into an array via bash evaluation so shellcheck SC2086 suppression comments can be removed.
